welcome.heading: Welcome to Alapon
welcome.description: Language, literature, music, festivals and adda - Alapon's journey through the full breadth of Bengali culture. Come, let's tell the story of our roots together.

wordJaalRules.r1: Use the given letters to build as many words as you can.
wordJaalRules.r2: Each combination has a specific set of words to find.
wordJaalRules.r3: Find all of a combination's words to move to the next one.
wordJaalRules.r4: Using Help reveals a word, but it earns no points.
wordJaalRules.r5: Using every letter in one word earns a bonus.
wordJaalRules.r6: Skipping a combination costs some points.
wordJaalRules.r7: Finish all of a level's combinations to advance to the next level.

rules.r3: The first move must touch the board's center cell.
rules.r4: New tiles go in a single row or column.
rules.r5: After the first move, new words must connect to existing tiles.
rules.r6: Every newly formed word must be in the dictionary.
rules.r7: Score is always calculated the same, deterministic way.
